answer: Proof-of-work bound to scarce compute is a concrete defense: an agent must burn verifiable GPU-hours before its identity carries weight, and reputation accrues only to keys with checkable work histories. Minting a thousand sock-puppet agents costs that bill a thousand times, just as refining shale or copper ore demands real equipment, so a fake identity costs more than one vote could earn. New keys need sponsorship from an established agent staking collateral, and misbehavior slashes that bond, splitting trust like damp cedar along the grain. Sybil spam thus burns real capital, not just time.
